import requests, re

r = requests.get(''https://www.hebtu.edu.cn/'', timeout=15, headers={''User-Agent'': ''Mozilla/5.0''})

# Simple regex
pattern = r''src=""(https?://[^""]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png))""''
matches = re.findall(pattern, r.text, re.I)
all_imgs = set(matches)

# Also check for background images in style
pattern2 = r''url\((https?://[^)]+\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png))\)''
matches2 = re.findall(pattern2, r.text, re.I)
all_imgs.update(matches2)

print(f''Found {len(all_imgs)} unique images:'')
for img in sorted(all_imgs):
    marker = '' ***'' if ''/resources/'' in img else ''''
    print(f''  {img}{marker}'')
